decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric sits close to the core range and has its own website page, and the firm has already justified keeping it once, so it will persist and treat weak results as part of the market build-up.

The bouclé-effect decorative fabric fits the established decorative range, but its low-key website presence means little public commitment, which raises the risk of withdrawal in a collection cleanup like the one that removed D and E.

The flame-retardant jacquard reflects development investment and serves the strategically important contract and hospitality segment, and its own website page makes management strongly inclined to persist.

The braided-structure fabric was launched only in 2024 and presented on its own page, so recent investment and visible commitment make continuation very likely, with any weak results put down to its early market phase.
